rung_purposes.purpose: Detect conveyor motor overload alarm based on healthy signal loss.
Reset general fault latch when fault reset pushbutton is pressed.
Generate fault summary from general fault, overload, or E-stop loss.
Run conveyor motor when in auto mode and no faults are present.
Detect pallet in position at stop photo-eye.
Latch stopper release solenoid on release request from line controller.
Start duration timer for stopper release actuation.
Unlatch stopper release solenoid when duration timer completes.
